about: Gate for `node scripts/review-bench.mjs score <dir> --gate`. null = not gated. Limits are the first recorded run plus slack for sampling noise (one clean run in nine is 0.11; two misses in 27 defects is 0.07); tighten them as the reviewer and the cases improve, and re-record after changing the cases or the parser.

recorded.reviewer_rules: code-reviewer principles with 7. A Blocker Must Be Provable (uncommitted at recording)
